method: Compare differences of Windows process creation wall time and recorded WSL monotonic Hello start/end. Absolute cross-clock offsets are not elapsed durations. Relative paired offsets assume no cross-clock jumps during the short serial series.
interpretation: The extra candidate Hello latency is consistent with delay before Windows reports native process creation, with only 7ms range in response-end minus creation offsets. This points to executable launch or inspection rather than Rust initialization/per-file thread work. Cause unproved; no Defender attribution or acceptance waiver.
